netlist:
C Cin VIN1 n1
L Lfb n1 VOUT1
L Ld VDD n3
L Ls n4 n5
NMOS M1 n3 n2 n4 VSS
NMOS M2 n5 n1 VSS VSS
C Cout n3 VOUT1
rationale: The proposed topology improves the binding constraints—particularly the high current draw (idd_ma) and poor gain (s21_db)—by replacing the resistive feedback (Rfb) with an inductive feedback (Lfb) to enhance impedance matching and increase gain while reducing quiescent current. The inductor introduces a parallel resonance at 915 MHz, improving both input match (s11_db) and power efficiency. This change simultaneously alleviates the most negative margins: idd_ma (currently 9.13 mA, target 4 mA), s21_db (8.58 dB, target 17 dB), and NF (1.602 dB, target 1.6 dB), while maintaining stability and keeping the device count within budget.
